items.summary:
Ford has filed for a new patent showing a multi-use tailgate on the front end of a truck, with the possibility of putting a whole television inside the tailgate. It seems likely to apply to the upcoming Fathom.

items.title: The CEO of a $55 billion conglomerate explains why the Japanese concept of 'kosoryoku' is so important in the AI age
items.summary: Sumitomo CEO Shingo Ueno uses AI to save time, but says it lacks "kosoryoku" — the human ability to envision and shape the future.
items.titleZh: 一家市值550亿美元的企业集团的首席执行官解释了为什么日本的“kosoryoku”概念在人工智能时代如此重要
items.summaryZh: 住友商事首席执行官上野信吾（Shingo Ueno）使用人工智能来节省时间，但表示它缺乏“kosoryoku”——人类设想和塑造未来的能力。
